content.short: Xade Finance is a Web3 wallet tool.
content.description: Xade Finance is a super app delivering traditional banking services powered by DeFi protocols, while offering the polished experience of a digital bank. Banks remain inefficient, opaque, and fragile, whereas DeFi has struggled with user experience and often operates within a closed ecosystem. The major obstacles in DeFi today are unsustainable economics and incentives, a tedious user journey, and limited real-world utility. Xade targets these gaps and aims to provide a more seamless, utility-driven DeFi banking experience.
